label: enemy
notes: Reads as the tail of a sentence — "Bullets pierce {effect}" — because that is the shape the card has always had.

label: [DRAFT] projectile lifetime
notes: André 3000's stat. Names how long everything the seal fires stays in the water — the card reads as a bare {effect}, so this label IS the card ("+25% <label>"). Two or three words, and it has to cover missiles and thrown shells as well as the gun, not just the pebbles.

label: recoil boost
notes: Sits at 0 by default, so recoil *= 1.3 measures as no change at all and {effect} correctly declines to claim one. The label is here for the day the base is raised off zero.

label: of everything you fire
notes: bare: the label is already a whole phrase ("of everything you fire"), so no noun is appended.

label: meter per chum
notes: percentOfOne: the stat is a fraction of a meter, so it reads better as a percentage of the thing it fills than as "+0.15".

label: element
unlock: an element on your shots and strike

label: harp seal
unlock: notes that charm the biggest enemy near you

label: razor clam
unlock: a spray of razor sharp razor clam blades

label: octopus grabber
unlock: an octopus buddy that reels in fish, and pops them into chum for you, {player}

label: orca family
unlock: 3 orca buddies who will attack yachts and other orca opps.

label: dolphin pod
unlock: a pod of dolphins working the surface
notes: The card that raises this is a STUB — disabled in upgrades.csv, and no system reads the stat yet (see CONFIG.upgrades.dolphinPod). The label is here anyway because npm run test:text fails on a stat without one: the day the card is switched on, its {effect} has to render as English rather than as dolphinPodLevel.

label: mussel barrage
unlock: on perfect strike, launches a bearded barrage of mussel munitions

label: club
unlock: a club in your fin slot.

label: thrown club
unlock: hurled homing clubs on a strike

label: club
notes: The Bouncer's four. Percentages rather than a level, because the card is a multiplier on a class rather than a level of anything — there is no "club power 3" to name, only the numbers it moved.

label: sonar teeth
unlock: shots that seek, favouring the biggest body in reach

label: maneater
unlock: a taste for swimmers — every one you eat raises all your damage
notes: Counts stacks and nothing else, deliberately: what a stack is WORTH depends on a running total, which is not visible from inside apply(). See applyDamageScaling in stats.js. That makes `level` the honest kind — {effect} would otherwise have to invent a number, which is the exact failure the measured descriptions exist to prevent.

label: iron lung
unlock: all damage scaling with your maximum oxygen
notes: Same as maneater: worth depends on a stat other cards move (max oxygen), so a measured number here would be a lie. Counts stacks only.
